note: Skill library: composed action templates that transfer across games. Each skill names an ontology ability, the button sequence that realises it, and the games where it has been measured. Written 2026-10-17. A new game's manual contributes abilities; the library supplies the button composition.

jump.description: leave the ground; land on a platform or clear a gap
jump.citation: Chip n Dale manual p.8: Press A to jump

jump-down.description: drop through a platform or fall deliberately
jump-down.citation: Chip n Dale manual p.9: press DOWN and A together to jump down

duck.description: lower the body to avoid a high attack
duck.citation: Chip n Dale manual p.8: Press DOWN to duck

pick-up.description: take hold of a nearby object
pick-up.citation: Chip n Dale manual p.8: Press B to pick up objects

throw-side.citation: Chip n Dale manual p.8: throw them right or left

throw-up.citation: Chip n Dale manual p.8: throw objects upwards by pressing UP

fire.citation: Contra manual p.9: B fires; Galaga p.5: A and B fire missiles

fire-eight.description: fire in one of eight directions, including left and diagonals
fire-eight.citation: Contra J manual p.10 control table: 左斜め下45°に発砲 etc.

strafe.citation: Galaga manual p.5: Move to the left / right

pick-and-throw-side.description: pick up a crate and hurl it at an enemy
pick-and-throw-side.citation: Chip n Dale manual p.8: pick up, then throw right or left

pick-and-throw-up.description: pick up and lob upward at a flying enemy

run-jump-throw.description: approach under cover of motion, then strike
run-jump-throw.citation: Chip n Dale manual p.8: move right, jump, throw

run-and-fire.description: reposition while shooting — the Galaga default
run-and-fire.citation: Galaga manual p.5: move and fire

transfers.note: When a new game's manual names an ability that matches a skill, the button sequence transfers. What does not transfer is the button mapping — that comes from the game's own control scan.
rules: ability named in the manual → look up the skill → get the phase structure
button assignment comes from controllability.py / the manual's control table
composition is game-specific: which skills chain depends on the level type
